sense: tired of having nothing interesting to do

pins.definition: Tired of having nothing interesting to do.
Feeling or showing impatience or lack of interest because nothing is engaging.
Not interesting; making you feel bored.

situation: A man sits at a tiny office desk on a slow afternoon, resting his heavy chin in the palm of his hand while staring blankly at a single stationary paperclip.
subject: the heavy, drooping posture of absolute lack of interest
brief: A man sits slouched at a small wooden desk, his head resting heavily in the palm of one hand while his other hand aimlessly taps a pencil against the edge. His eyelids are half-closed in utter listlessness, and a single grey coffee mug sits untouched beside a stack of blank papers.
prompt: A man sits slouched at a small wooden desk, his head resting heavily in the palm of one hand while his other hand aimlessly taps a pencil against the edge.
